summary: Chain Bridge I, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement: Amendment No. 1 to an existing $1.25M unsecured non-interest-bearing promissory note (extending maturity to Nov 2026) and issuance of new $312.5M principal notes at $250K cash (OID), due Nov 2026, to fund business combination expenses. No change of control, business combination, or shareholder value event is described. This is routine financing for a SPAC seeking a target, not a special situation. The filing is a standard current report on debt modifications/issuances.
